references.text: The same construction principle with forty silver sockets and two sockets under each plank is mentioned for the southern side of the tabernacle.
Describes eight planks with sixteen silver sockets for the back of the tabernacle, following the same pattern with two sockets under each plank.
Parallel text describing the actual execution of the instructions, with forty silver sockets for the planks on the north side.
Mentions the use of silver from the census to cast the sockets for the sanctuary and the curtain.
The Merarite Levites were responsible for the planks, bars, pillars, and sockets of the tabernacle.
Describes the task of the Merarites in carrying the tabernacle's planks, bars, pillars, and sockets.
Confirms the details of the construction of the sanctuary and emphasizes the accuracy of God's plan.
